name: Tracey
text: I had reki from penny a few years ago when I had a sore arm I didn’t think it would stop the pain but I was surprised when it did I would definitely recommend it.

name: Michelle
text: I have frequently received Reiki from Penny and cannot recommend her enough. She is a powerful spiritual healer with such a nurturing, intuitive and calming presence. Every session leaves me feeling deeply relaxed, grounded and more connected to myself. Penny has a beautiful way of creating a safe and nurturing space where you can let go, unwind and reconnect with your true self. I’m so grateful for her gift and the care she brings to every session 🩷

name: Emma
text: I recieved numerous distance reiki sessions with Penny. Such a relaxing experience and not what i expected at all. Would definely recommend.
Reiki with Penny was so calm and relaxing... what a beautiful state to be in. Heartara is certainly an apt description of my experience - so many colours for me. Thanks Penny

name: Liz
text: was so relaxing, i didnt want it to end!

name: Sharon
text: This is one of the best holistic therapies i have ever recieved. Carried out by not only a Reiki Master but a sensitive understanding person. I genuinely cannot recommend Heartara enough, it is definitely a must do again therapy.
